title: Paying workspaces
definition: Distinct non-test workspaces with positive recurring value in the normalized healthy_paid subscription state at asOf; delinquent, trial and one-time-purchase-only workspaces are separate cohorts.
limitations: healthy_paid requires provider/entitlement reconciliation under a versioned status policy. Do not silently include one-time credit purchasers.

title: Healthy recurring MRR
definition: Sum approved recurring net subscription amounts normalized to one month, excluding tax, trials and top-ups; healthy status policy fixed.
limitations: Annual/12; multi-currency separate; do not equate to collections or recognized revenue.

title: Delinquent contracted MRR
definition: Recurring contracted value for delinquent subscriptions under the chosen policy, separate from healthy MRR.
limitations: Grace and canceled states are versioned, never silently blended.

title: New MRR
definition: First paid recurring MRR created in interval from previously nonpaying workspaces.
limitations: Reactivation is separate, not new acquisition.

title: Expansion MRR
definition: Positive recurring value change in opening paid cohort, excluding reactivation/new workspaces.
limitations: Normalize currency/discount policy consistently.

title: Contraction MRR
definition: Absolute recurring value decreases in retained members of opening paid cohort.
limitations: Full churn excluded to avoid double count.

title: Churned MRR
definition: Opening recurring value lost when qualifying paid relationship ends under fixed policy.
limitations: Cancellation intent is not automatically effective churn.

title: Successful collections
definition: Sum captured successful payment amounts by event time and native currency.
limitations: Exclude authorizations/unpaid invoices; taxes shown separately for net-revenue analysis.

title: Succeeded refunds
definition: Sum succeeded refund amounts, deduplicated by refund ID.
limitations: Pending/failed refunds are not succeeded refunds.

title: Net dispute withdrawals
definition: Withdrawn dispute funds minus reinstated funds; reconcile overlapping refunds.
limitations: No double counting when refund and dispute affect the same underlying amount.

title: Net collections
definition: Successful collections minus succeeded refunds minus net dispute withdrawals, with reconciliation of overlaps.
limitations: Payouts and fees separate; cash basis, not recognized revenue.

title: Eligible invoice recovery rate
definition: Recovered eligible failed invoices / eligible failed invoices whose fixed recovery window has matured.
limitations: Show amount-weighted and count-based separately; spontaneous recovery is not automatically incremental impact.

title: Net revenue retention
definition: (Opening MRR + expansion - contraction - churn) / opening MRR for the same cohort/currency.
limitations: Exclude new customer MRR; zero denominator unavailable.

title: Gross revenue retention
definition: (Opening MRR - contraction - churn) / opening MRR.
limitations: No expansion; consistent status policy required.

title: Paid workspace churn
definition: Opening paid workspaces that end paid service / opening paid workspaces.
limitations: Do not substitute user inactivity or account deletion for billing churn.

title: Estimated contribution
definition: Approved period-consistent revenue basis minus attributable operating costs with cost completeness metadata.
limitations: Label cash contribution when recognition absent; unallocated overhead explicit.

title: Provider cost coverage
definition: Attempts with verified actual cost / all billable or potentially billable attempts.
limitations: Missing/unknown attempts in denominator; never silently zero.

title: Active users
definition: Distinct non-test users with a specified meaningful application event in the interval.
limitations: Event definition versioned; a pageview-only DAU is a different metric.

title: Active workspaces
definition: Distinct non-test workspaces with a meaningful completed outcome in interval.
limitations: A user belonging to several workspaces must not collapse workspace grain.

title: Activation rate
definition: Eligible new workspaces with first-value event within 7 days / eligible workspaces whose 7-day window matured.
limitations: 7-day window proposed; user-confirmed usefulness and proxies must not be mixed.

title: Time to first value
definition: Distribution of first-value event time minus verified signup time.
limitations: Report censored/nonactivated separately; median among completers is not all-user experience.

title: D7 first-value return
definition: Workspaces with meaningful return in [day7,day8) / first-value workspaces observed through day8.
limitations: Reporting-day convention fixed; immature workspaces excluded.

title: D28 first-value return
definition: Workspaces with meaningful return in [day28,day29) / eligible mature first-value workspaces.
limitations: No forecast disguised as observed retention.

title: Feature adoption
definition: Active eligible workspaces completing the feature event / active workspaces eligible to use that feature.
limitations: Eligibility matters; correlations with retention are not causal effects.

title: Task completion rate
definition: Successfully completed authoritative tasks / started tasks with terminal observation window elapsed.
limitations: Canceled/unknown states shown separately; retries not counted as new user tasks.

title: Verified publication rate
definition: Verified external publications / eligible approved publications whose observation window elapsed.
limitations: Submitted/approved/confirming is not verified live.

title: Useful completed outcomes
definition: Distinct completed tasks explicitly rated useful; proxy-confirmed outputs reported in separate series.
limitations: Missing feedback is not negative or positive feedback.

title: Automation occurrence success
definition: Verified successful occurrences / eligible due occurrences with observation window elapsed.
limitations: Skipped, held and paused distinguished from failures.

title: Observed AI provider cost
definition: Sum known actual provider receipt cost, preserving source currency and cost state.
limitations: Estimated and unknown costs separate; no client-supplied prices.

title: Absorbed failed-task cost
definition: Known actual provider costs assigned to failed/nonbillable user outcomes.
limitations: Shows platform cost, not automatically refundable customer charges.

title: Cost per useful task
definition: Attributed cost in completed useful-task cohort / useful outcomes in the same cohort.
limitations: Coverage and selection bias must be shown; no zero division.

title: Evaluation pass rate
definition: Cases passing declared quality/correctness rubric / evaluated cases in comparable suite.
limitations: Synthetic, human and production feedback separate; no LLM grade as security proof.

title: AI attempt latency
definition: Distribution of request dispatch to completion/failure under a fixed timeout/cancel policy.
limitations: Streaming first-token and total latency are distinct.

title: End-to-end task latency
definition: Distribution of task accepted to verified terminal result.
limitations: Do not average provider p95s to infer task p95.

title: Credits granted
definition: Sum immutable grant events by approved source and period.
limitations: Goodwill, subscription and purchased credits shown separately; not revenue.

title: Credits consumed
definition: Sum settled consumed credits by terminal task outcome.
limitations: Reservation is not consumption.

title: Available credits
definition: Existing wallet projection after holds, expiry, reversals and debt.
limitations: Do not independently reimplement mutable balance logic.

title: Held credits
definition: Outstanding reservations under current wallet/unknown settlement rules.
limitations: Unknown outcomes not silently released or charged twice.

title: Credit debt
definition: Current debt from valid reversals after consumption, as projected by existing wallet.
limitations: Debt is not automatically a cash receivable.

title: API server error rate
definition: Eligible 5xx/application-failure requests / eligible served requests.
limitations: Expected client denials separate; sampled numerator and denominator compatible.

title: API latency
definition: Observed eligible request duration distribution.
limitations: Sample/region/cache status included.

title: Queue age
definition: Now minus eligible enqueue time for pending runnable jobs.
limitations: Paused/scheduled-future jobs excluded or separate.

title: Error budget burn rate
definition: Observed bad-event fraction / allowed bad-event fraction for approved SLO.
limitations: Undefined until SLO and denominator approved; not measured uptime promise.

title: Incident affected workspaces
definition: Distinct workspaces with linked verified failing events.
limitations: Coverage-limited lower bound unless complete; not guessed customer count.

title: Source data lag
definition: Now minus last complete source watermark.
limitations: Distinguish event silence from ingestion heartbeat failure.

title: Open support tickets
definition: Tickets not in resolved/closed/spam/duplicate, grouped by actual state.
limitations: Waiting state remains visible; test tickets excluded.

title: First human response time
definition: First public human response minus creation excluding declared nonbusiness intervals.
limitations: AI acknowledgment not human response; unanswered tickets shown censored/aged.

title: Support resolution time
definition: Resolved time minus created time under versioned pause/business-time policy.
limitations: Unresolved tickets not hidden; reopening policy fixed.

title: Positive CSAT
definition: Positive qualified responses / valid responses; response rate displayed alongside.
limitations: No broad satisfaction claim from very low response sample.

title: Repeat issue rate
definition: Resolved cases with same verified issue recurrence within 14 days / cases observed through 14 days.
limitations: Similarity alone does not prove duplicate cause.

title: Required check coverage
definition: Passed required checks / required checks; failed, skipped, blocked and not-run separately counted.
limitations: Never averaged to override a single mandatory failed security/financial gate.

title: Check failures
definition: Count failures by functional, infrastructure, timeout, canceled or unknown classification.
limitations: ENOSPC infrastructure failure is not a product bug.

title: Test instability
definition: Tests with mixed outcomes on unchanged code/environment / tests rerun under the declared policy.
limitations: Rerun selection bias disclosed; flaky tests not simply ignored.

title: Unresolved high-severity findings
definition: Distinct current high/critical findings not fixed or validly waived, by scanner/rule/version.
limitations: Scanner coverage/entitlement explicit; no guarantee all vulnerabilities found.

title: Organic search clicks
definition: Search Console reported clicks for authorized property and chosen dimensions.
limitations: Top-row/aggregation limits retained; no per-user attribution.

title: Organic search CTR
definition: Reported clicks / impressions in exactly the same aggregate.
limitations: Average position is distinct; no averaged CTR across unequal denominators.

title: Known acquisition source coverage
definition: New workspaces with recorded allowed acquisition source / all new workspaces.
limitations: Unknown attribution is retained, not assigned to direct by default.

title: Source-to-paid conversion
definition: Attributed workspaces becoming qualifying paid within 30 days / source workspaces observed through day30.
limitations: Proposed window; immature cohorts excluded.

title: Attributed acquisition cost
definition: Approved attributable acquisition spend / new qualifying paying workspaces in compatible attribution window.
limitations: Unavailable when spend or attribution incomplete; not blended with LTV projection.

title: Observed recovery associated with decisions
definition: Deduplicated actual recovered payment receipts linked to decisions, labeled associated unless incremental effect measured.
limitations: Avoid double credit across several recommendations.

title: Estimated experiment effect
definition: Predeclared treatment-control difference with uncertainty under the approved analysis plan.
limitations: Only if sample/assignment checks pass; otherwise inconclusive.

title: Estimated time back
definition: Reuse approved baseline-minus-measured-effort methodology and version, if available and verified.
limitations: Not invented hours saved; unavailable until current source/definition verified.

title: Reactivated MRR
definition: Recurring value restored for a previously paid, fully churned workspace in the interval; not new MRR or opening-cohort expansion.
limitations: Report reactivation separately in MRR bridge; opening paid-cohort NRR does not silently acquire returning churned accounts.

title: Paid customers
definition: Distinct active owner users (profile not deleted) of workspaces whose subscription has provider<>fixture and status in (active, past_due) at asOf; window grouping reads the daily subscription snapshot.
limitations: No subscription history before the first daily snapshot; trial (fixture) subscriptions never count.

title: Paid workspaces
definition: Distinct workspaces whose subscription has provider<>fixture and status in (active, past_due) at asOf; window grouping reads the daily subscription snapshot.
limitations: Same snapshot limits as paid_customers; one-time credit purchasers are not paid workspaces.

title: Subscriptions by plan and status
definition: Count of non-fixture subscriptions grouped by plan label and status at asOf.
limitations: Status 'grace' is never produced today; a plan may fall back to trial terms when a price is unbound.

title: Cash collected
definition: Sum of funded live-mode credit orders plus live-mode credit-plan invoice grants in the half-open interval, by native currency.
limitations: Partial by construction: legacy plan invoices and provider fees are not recorded; reconcile against the provider balance.

title: Payment failures
definition: payment_failed billing notices plus failed credit orders in the interval.
limitations: Dunning attempt counts live with the provider and are not stored.

title: Refunds and disputes
definition: Sum of succeeded refunds and non-withdrawn disputes by category, status and native currency, attributed to a workspace through the payment intent when possible.
limitations: Legacy plan refunds have no join path and are reported as unattributed coverage.

title: AI cost (actual)
definition: Sum of actual_usd_micro over settle rows with cost_state=actual; coverage reports settle rows still estimated_unknown.
limitations: Stale turns may be settled from estimates; provider invoices are not yet imported for reconciliation.

title: AI cost (unknown)
definition: Sum of estimated_usd_micro and count of ledger rows whose cost_state is estimated_unknown in the interval.
limitations: Rows leave this metric only through reconciliation; never add it to actual cost.

title: AI cost by feature
definition: ai_cost_actual grouped by the feature derived from the ledger idempotency_key prefix (feature is always a dimension).
limitations: The prefix is a convention, not a constraint; unknown prefixes land in other.

title: AI cost versus cash collected
definition: ai_cost_actual divided by cash_collected for the same interval and currency; only USD cash is comparable to the USD ledger.
limitations: Both sides keep their own coverage; a zero cash denominator is not_applicable.

title: Founder operations cost
definition: Settled ledger cost for aiUsageExempt rows, costCenter=founder_ops rows and workspaces classified internal; never part of customer metrics.
limitations: Includes only excluded activity; estimates stand in where no actual cost exists.

title: Budget remaining
definition: stop_usd_micro minus (spent + reserved) per pr_budgets scope for the current window.
limitations: Current window only; no budget history.

title: Active workspaces
definition: Distinct non-excluded workspaces with a completed or applied agent run or a publish event in the interval (definition v1).
limitations: Product events are not yet instrumented; activity is agent runs and publish events only.

title: Publish outcomes
definition: Count of publish.verified, publish.failed and publish.uncertain notification events in the interval; coverage numerator is verified, denominator all.
limitations: Only produced while notifications v2 is enabled; otherwise unavailable, never zero.

title: Cron heartbeat age
definition: Seconds since the last recorded cron probe in rafii_control.source_health (source_id='cron'); older than 180 seconds is stale.
limitations: No heartbeat row means monitoring is unavailable, not that the worker is healthy.

title: Notification deliveries
definition: Count of notification deliveries created in the interval by channel, status and failure class.
limitations: Email delivered states arrive only through provider webhooks.

title: Phone calls
definition: Count of phone calls requested in the interval by kind, direction, provider, state and failure class, with telephony plus live cost and duration as measures.
limitations: Ambiguous calls are reported as unknown coverage.

title: Source health
definition: Per source: age in seconds since the last good watermark with the recorded state and reason code.
limitations: Sources without a probe row are unavailable.

title: Data request backlog
definition: Count of pr_data_requests with status='requested' by kind and age band at asOf.
limitations: Not a ticket system; support conversations are not collected.

title: Security events
definition: Count of content-free security audit events (session alerts, MFA changes, session revocations, API token changes) in the interval.
limitations: Control-plane denied attempts live in admin_audit_log and are read separately.
